runs.text: In the dolls that open one inside another, in which doll does the work of opening end?
The base case is the one that no longer holds a smaller version of the problem. Without it, opening dolls would never end.

justification.text: It is where you start, but it opens and holds another.

runs.text: The smallest doll, which does not open.

justification.text: It holds none: it is solved without opening another.
All the ones in the middle hold a smaller one.
